== Biography ==
Margaret was born about 1850. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-987|Thomas Glasgow]] and [[McCracken-5681|Maryann unknown]]. 

Married John Jebb<ref>https://www.genesreunited.co.uk/boards/board/general_topics/thread/465937</ref>
A marriage for Margaret Glasgow and Jebb was registered on 24 November 1874 in the Ballymena district.<ref>[https://geni.nidirect.gov.uk/search/marriage GRONI civil marriage index], 24 November 1874, Ballymena district, M/1874/H1/230/1/76.</ref>
